description: Full-text search across tasks with relevance ranking. Alternative to list_tasks for text-based discovery. Supports quoted phrases, exclusions (-term), and inline filters (dartboard:Name, status:Done, assignee:Name).

include_completed.description: Include completed tasks in results (default: false)

query.description: Search query. Supports quoted phrases ("exact match"), exclusions (-term), inline filters (dartboard:Name, status:Done), and regular terms.

name: search_tasks
